cases.prompt: Audit my whole repository for bugs, data loss, and simplifications.
Review the changes in my latest pull request.

Explain how the authentication middleware works in this codebase.

Plan a four-phase migration with independent verification gates.

Reflect on the completed debugging episode and extract candidate lessons.
Promote a recurring learning only if it survives replay and retention tests.
Audit agent instructions for stale model-specific workarounds.
Design a bounded agent model-tool loop with explicit stop states.
Compare a coding agent across repeated tasks with outcome and token metrics.

Compare three independent solutions for the same task.
Split a broad repository search into independent coverage slices.

Write the commit message for my staged change that fixes the null-user crash.

Open a pull request for this branch with a proper title and body.
Is there an installable skill that helps debug Kubernetes cluster networking?

Draw the payment flow as a statechart and show the shortest path from my TLA+ spec to the double-charge bug.
Help me really understand how our cache invalidation works before I touch it.
Rewrite this README section so each sentence is short and states one instruction.

Review the discriminated union types in this .ts file and replace the optional-field bag.
Remove the AI-sounding filler from this PR description before I post it.
Write a Kaggle benchmark task that checks an LLM's arithmetic, then push it.
